tickets.title: US002: Barcode Scanner for Textbooks
tickets.description:
As a Student selling items, I want to scan a textbook's barcode using my phone's camera, so that the app automatically populates the ISBN and Title without manual typing.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The app successfully opens the device camera and captures standard ISBN barcodes.
2. Pass/Fail: The system queries an external book database and auto-fills the "Title" and "ISBN" input fields based on the scanned code.
